summary: {member} asks the board to try a drawing passed over for the front on the back.
realLife: While considering five views of Little Rock Central High School for the reverse, the committee also scored a set of scales originally submitted for the obverse. The issued dollar showed the school building on the reverse and nine stars beside the students on the front.
inGame: needs: the shortlist for each face and the brief for the reverse.

turns.pulledBy: There is room to reopen the reverse ballot.
turns.what: The scales make the ballot alongside the building.
turns.writesBack: The two subjects split the vote.

turns.pulledBy: The reverse must show the school itself.
turns.writesBack: The chair keeps the scales off the ballot.
